import math
import clients = "./clients.qui"
import masks = "./masks.qui"

class Member(int client, op := false, voice := false)
class Ban(string mask, string setter, int tick)
class Channel(string name, int created)
    active := true
    Member[] members := []
    topic := ""
    topic_setter := ""
    topic_time := -1
    Ban[] bans := []
    flags := distinct<string>()
    .flags.add("n")
    .flags.add("t")
    key := ""
    limit := 0
    peak := 0
    messages := 0

int member(Channel channel, int client)
    for: i < int(#channel.members)
        if channel.members[i].client == client
            return i
    return -1

string status(Member entry)
    return if entry.op then "@" elif entry.voice then "+" else ""

void add(Channel &channel, int client)
    channel.members = channel.members.append(Member(client, #channel.members == 0))
    channel.peak = math.max(channel.peak, int(#channel.members))

void remove(Channel &channel, int client)
    channel.members = [for item := channel.members[] if item.client != client then item]

bool banned(Channel channel, clients.Client client)
    for ban := channel.bans[]
        if masks.matches(ban.mask, clients.prefix(client))
            return true
    return false

bool can_speak(Channel channel, clients.Client client, int index)
    position := member(channel, index)
    privileged := position >= 0 and (channel.members[position].op or channel.members[position].voice)
    return (position >= 0 or not channel.flags.has("n")) and (not channel.flags.has("m") or privileged) and (privileged or not banned(channel, client))

string names(Channel channel, clients.Client[] people, int viewer)
    inside := member(channel, viewer) >= 0
    string[] result := []
    for entry := channel.members[]
        if inside or not people[entry.client].invisible
            result = result.append(status(entry) + people[entry.client].nickname)
    return result.join(" ")

string mode_display(Channel channel, include_key := true)
    result := "+"
    for: i < 6
        flag := "iklmnt"[i]
        bool present := if flag == "k" then channel.key != "" elif flag == "l" then channel.limit > 0 else channel.flags.has(flag)
        if present
            result += flag
    if include_key and channel.key != ""
        result += " " + channel.key
    if channel.limit > 0
        result += " {channel.limit}"
    return result

class Client(string identifier, string host, int connected, int tokens)
    active := true
    nickname := ""
    username := ""
    realname := ""
    invisible := false
    registered := false
    signon := -1
    last_received := connected
    last_speaking := -1
    ping_sent := -1
    refill_time := -1
    string[] queue := []
    int[] channels := []
    int[] invites := []
    away := ""
    received := 0
    sent := 0

string addressee(Client client)
    return if client.nickname == "" then "*" else client.nickname

string prefix(Client client)
    return "{client.nickname}!{client.username}@{client.host}"

string mode(Client client)
    return if client.invisible then "+i" else "+"

void use_token(Client &client, int tick, int capacity, int interval)
    if client.tokens == capacity
        client.refill_time = tick + interval
    client.tokens -= 1

void refill(Client &client, int tick, int capacity, int interval)
    if client.refill_time == tick
        client.tokens += 1
        client.refill_time = if client.tokens < capacity then tick + interval else -1

import math
import protocol = "./protocol.qui"
import masks = "./masks.qui"
import clients = "./clients.qui"
import channels = "./channels.qui"
import modes = "./modes.qui"

class Settings(map<string, string> values, string[] motd)
class Traffic(int tick, string identifier, string kind, string body)
class Server(Settings settings, Traffic[] traffic)
    tick := 0
    int end := traffic[-1].tick
    clients.Client[] people := []
    channels.Channel[] rooms := []
    string[] sent := []
    commands := map<string, int>()
    numerics := map<int, int>()
    counts := map<string, int>()
    disconnections := map<string, int>()
    string[] gone := []
    peak_connections := 0
    peak_connection_time := 0
    peak_registered := 0
    peak_registration_time := 0

string setting(Settings settings, string key)
    match settings.values.get(key)
        string value
            return value
        none
            return ""

int number(Settings settings, string key)
    return int(setting(settings, key))

string[] input_lines(string path)
    source := file.read(path)
    string[] result := []
    while .source(string &line)
        result = result.append(line)
    return result

int first_space(string line, int start)
    position := start
    while position < int(#line) and line[position] != " "
        position += 1
    return position

Settings read_settings()
    map<string, string> values
    string[] motd := []
    for line := input_lines("input/server.txt")[]
        split := first_space(line, 0)
        key := line[0:<split]
        value := line[split + 1:]
        if key == "MOTD"
            motd = motd.append(value)
        else
            .values.set(key, value)
    return Settings(values, motd)

Traffic[] read_traffic()
    Traffic[] result := []
    for line := input_lines("input/traffic.txt")[]
        first := first_space(line, 0)
        second := first_space(line, first + 1)
        body := line[second + 1:]
        kind := "messages"
        if body.starts_with("CONNECT ")
            host := body[8:]
            valid := #host >= 1 and #host <= 63
            for: i < int(#host)
                if not (protocol.letters() + "0123456789.-").contains(host[i])
                    valid = false
            if valid
                kind = "connect"
        elif body == "DISCONNECT"
            kind = "disconnect"
        result = result.append(Traffic(int(line[0:<first]), line[first + 1:<second], kind, body))
    return result

int count(map<string, int> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

bool contains(int[] values, int wanted)
    for value := values[]
        if value == wanted
            return true
    return false

int connection(Server server, string identifier)
    for: index < int(#server.people)
        if server.people[index].active and server.people[index].identifier == identifier
            return index
    return -1

int find_user(Server server, string nickname)
    folded := protocol.fold(nickname)
    for: index < int(#server.people)
        client := server.people[index]
        if client.active and client.registered and protocol.fold(client.nickname) == folded
            return index
    return -1

int find_channel(Server server, string name)
    folded := protocol.fold(name)
    for: index < int(#server.rooms)
        if server.rooms[index].active and protocol.fold(server.rooms[index].name) == folded
            return index
    return -1

void send(Server &server, int client, string line)
    server.sent = server.sent.append("{server.tick} {server.people[client].identifier} {line}")
    server.people[client].sent += 1

void reply(Server &server, int client, int code, string content)
    .server.numerics.increment(code)
    send(&server, client, ":" + setting(server.settings, "NAME") + " {code:03.} " + clients.addressee(server.people[client]) + " " + content)

void broadcast(Server &server, int room, string line, exclude := -1)
    for member := server.rooms[room].members[]
        if member.client != exclude
            send(&server, member.client, line)

void send_peers(Server &server, int client, string line)
    for: other < int(#server.people)
        if other == client or not server.people[other].active
            continue
        peer := false
        for room := server.people[client].channels[]
            if channels.member(server.rooms[room], other) >= 0
                peer = true
        if peer
            send(&server, other, line)

string joined_channels(Server server, int client, string separator)
    string[] names := []
    for room := server.people[client].channels[]
        position := channels.member(server.rooms[room], client)
        names = names.append(channels.status(server.rooms[room].members[position]) + server.rooms[room].name)
    return names.join(separator)

void remove_member(Server &server, int client, int room)
    channels.remove(&server.rooms[room], client)
    server.people[client].channels = [for index := server.people[client].channels[] if index != room then index]
    if #server.rooms[room].members == 0
        server.rooms[room].active = false
        for: index < int(#server.people)
            server.people[index].invites = [for value := server.people[index].invites[] if value != room then value]

void disconnect(Server &server, int index, string reason, string kind)
    client := server.people[index]
    if kind != "closed"
        send(&server, index, "ERROR :Closing Link: " + clients.addressee(client) + "[{client.host}] ({reason})")
        .server.counts.increment("errors")
    if client.registered
        send_peers(&server, index, ":" + clients.prefix(client) + " QUIT :" + reason)
    for room := client.channels[]
        remove_member(&server, index, room)
    .server.counts.increment("discarded", by = int(#server.people[index].queue))
    server.people[index].queue = []
    server.people[index].active = false
    server.gone = server.gone.append("GONE {server.tick} {client.identifier} " + clients.addressee(client) + " " + reason)
    .server.disconnections.increment(kind)

void complete_registration(Server &server, int index)
    &client := &server.people[index]
    if client.registered or client.nickname == "" or client.username == ""
        return
    client.registered = true
    client.signon = server.tick
    client.last_speaking = server.tick
    registered := 0
    for person := server.people[]
        if person.active and person.registered
            registered += 1
    if registered > server.peak_registered
        server.peak_registered = registered
        server.peak_registration_time = server.tick
    name := setting(server.settings, "NAME")
    version := setting(server.settings, "VERSION")
    reply(&server, index, 1, ":Welcome to the Internet Relay Network " + clients.prefix(client))
    reply(&server, index, 2, ":Your host is {name}, running version {version}")
    reply(&server, index, 3, ":This server was created " + setting(server.settings, "CREATED"))
    reply(&server, index, 4, "{name} {version} i biklmnotv")
    reply(&server, index, 5, "CASEMAPPING=rfc1459 CHANTYPES=# NICKLEN=" + setting(server.settings, "NICKLEN") + " CHANNELLEN=" + setting(server.settings, "CHANNELLEN") + " TOPICLEN=" + setting(server.settings, "TOPICLEN") + " CHANLIMIT=#:" + setting(server.settings, "MAXCHANNELS") + " CHANMODES=b,k,l,imnt PREFIX=(ov)@+ :are supported by this server")
    reply(&server, index, 375, ":- {name} Message of the day -")
    for line := server.settings.motd[]
        reply(&server, index, 372, ":- " + line)
    reply(&server, index, 376, ":End of /MOTD command.")
    if client.invisible
        send(&server, index, ":{client.nickname} MODE {client.nickname} :+i")

void names_reply(Server &server, int client, int room)
    names := channels.names(server.rooms[room], server.people, client)
    name := server.rooms[room].name
    if names != ""
        reply(&server, client, 353, "= {name} :{names}")
    reply(&server, client, 366, "{name} :End of /NAMES list.")

void topic_reply(Server &server, int client, int room)
    channel := server.rooms[room]
    if channel.topic == ""
        reply(&server, client, 331, "{channel.name} :No topic is set")
    else
        reply(&server, client, 332, "{channel.name} :{channel.topic}")
        reply(&server, client, 333, "{channel.name} {channel.topic_setter} {channel.topic_time}")

void nick(Server &server, int index, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters == 0 or parameters[0] == ""
        reply(&server, index, 431, ":No nickname given")
        return
    name := parameters[0][0:<math.min(int(#parameters[0]), number(server.settings, "NICKLEN"))]
    if not protocol.valid_nickname(name)
        reply(&server, index, 432, "{name} :Erroneous nickname")
        return
    if name == server.people[index].nickname
        return
    for: other < int(#server.people)
        if other != index and server.people[other].active and server.people[other].nickname != "" and protocol.fold(server.people[other].nickname) == protocol.fold(name)
            reply(&server, index, 433, "{name} :Nickname is already in use")
            return
    if server.people[index].registered
        line := ":" + clients.prefix(server.people[index]) + " NICK :" + name
        send(&server, index, line)
        send_peers(&server, index, line)
    server.people[index].nickname = name
    complete_registration(&server, index)

void user(Server &server, int index, string[] parameters)
    if server.people[index].username != ""
        reply(&server, index, 462, ":You may not reregister")
        return
    if #parameters < 4
        reply(&server, index, 461, "USER :Not enough parameters")
        return
    server.people[index].username = parameters[0]
    server.people[index].realname = parameters[3]
    server.people[index].invisible = protocol.digits(parameters[1]) and #parameters[1] <= 3 and (int(parameters[1]) / 8) % 2 == 1
    complete_registration(&server, index)

void join(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters == 0
        reply(&server, client, 461, "JOIN :Not enough parameters")
        return
    prefix := clients.prefix(server.people[client])
    if parameters[0] == "0"
        rooms := server.people[client].channels
        for room := rooms[]
            broadcast(&server, room, ":{prefix} PART {server.rooms[room].name}")
            remove_member(&server, client, room)
        return
    names := parameters[0].split(",")
    string[] keys := if #parameters >= 2 then parameters[1].split(",") else []
    for: i < int(#names)
        name := names[i]
        key := if i < int(#keys) then keys[i] else ""
        if not protocol.valid_channel(name, number(server.settings, "CHANNELLEN"))
            reply(&server, client, 403, "{name} :No such channel")
            continue
        room := find_channel(server, name)
        if room >= 0 and channels.member(server.rooms[room], client) >= 0
            continue
        if int(#server.people[client].channels) >= number(server.settings, "MAXCHANNELS")
            reply(&server, client, 405, "{name} :You have joined too many channels")
            continue
        if room < 0
            room = int(#server.rooms)
            server.rooms = server.rooms.append(channels.Channel(name, server.tick))
        else
            channel := server.rooms[room]
            invited := contains(server.people[client].invites, room)
            error_code := if channels.banned(channel, server.people[client]) and not invited then 474 elif channel.flags.has("i") and not invited then 473 elif channel.key != "" and key != channel.key then 475 elif channel.limit > 0 and int(#channel.members) >= channel.limit then 471 else 0
            if error_code > 0
                flag := if error_code == 474 then "b" elif error_code == 473 then "i" elif error_code == 475 then "k" else "l"
                reply(&server, client, error_code, "{channel.name} :Cannot join channel (+{flag})")
                continue
        server.people[client].invites = [for value := server.people[client].invites[] if value != room then value]
        channels.add(&server.rooms[room], client)
        server.people[client].channels = server.people[client].channels.append(room)
        broadcast(&server, room, ":{prefix} JOIN {server.rooms[room].name}")
        if server.rooms[room].topic != ""
            topic_reply(&server, client, room)
        names_reply(&server, client, room)

void part(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters == 0
        reply(&server, client, 461, "PART :Not enough parameters")
        return
    suffix := if #parameters >= 2 and parameters[1] != "" then " :" + parameters[1] else ""
    prefix := clients.prefix(server.people[client])
    for name := parameters[0].split(",")[]
        room := find_channel(server, name)
        if room < 0
            reply(&server, client, 403, "{name} :No such channel")
        elif channels.member(server.rooms[room], client) < 0
            reply(&server, client, 442, "{server.rooms[room].name} :You're not on that channel")
        else
            broadcast(&server, room, ":{prefix} PART {server.rooms[room].name}{suffix}")
            remove_member(&server, client, room)

void message(Server &server, int client, string command, string[] parameters)
    notice := command == "NOTICE"
    if not notice
        server.people[client].last_speaking = server.tick
    if #parameters == 0 or parameters[0] == ""
        if not notice
            reply(&server, client, 411, ":No recipient given ({command})")
        return
    if #parameters < 2 or parameters[1] == ""
        if not notice
            reply(&server, client, 412, ":No text to send")
        return
    prefix := clients.prefix(server.people[client])
    text := parameters[1]
    for target := parameters[0].split(",")[]
        if target.starts_with("#")
            room := find_channel(server, target)
            if room < 0
                if not notice
                    reply(&server, client, 401, "{target} :No such nick/channel")
            elif not channels.can_speak(server.rooms[room], server.people[client], client)
                if not notice
                    reply(&server, client, 404, "{server.rooms[room].name} :Cannot send to channel")
            else
                server.rooms[room].messages += 1
                broadcast(&server, room, ":{prefix} {command} {server.rooms[room].name} :{text}", client)
        else
            other := find_user(server, target)
            if other < 0
                if not notice
                    reply(&server, client, 401, "{target} :No such nick/channel")
            else
                send(&server, other, ":{prefix} {command} {server.people[other].nickname} :{text}")
                if not notice and server.people[other].away != ""
                    reply(&server, client, 301, "{server.people[other].nickname} :{server.people[other].away}")

void topic(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters == 0
        reply(&server, client, 461, "TOPIC :Not enough parameters")
        return
    room := find_channel(server, parameters[0])
    if room < 0
        reply(&server, client, 403, "{parameters[0]} :No such channel")
        return
    member := channels.member(server.rooms[room], client)
    if member < 0
        reply(&server, client, 442, "{server.rooms[room].name} :You're not on that channel")
        return
    if #parameters == 1
        topic_reply(&server, client, room)
        return
    if server.rooms[room].flags.has("t") and not server.rooms[room].members[member].op
        reply(&server, client, 482, "{server.rooms[room].name} :You're not channel operator")
        return
    &channel := &server.rooms[room]
    channel.topic = parameters[1][0:<math.min(int(#parameters[1]), number(server.settings, "TOPICLEN"))]
    channel.topic_setter = server.people[client].nickname
    channel.topic_time = server.tick
    broadcast(&server, room, ":" + clients.prefix(server.people[client]) + " TOPIC {channel.name} :{channel.topic}")

void handle_names(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters == 0
        reply(&server, client, 366, "* :End of /NAMES list.")
        return
    for name := parameters[0].split(",")[]
        room := find_channel(server, name)
        if room < 0
            reply(&server, client, 366, "{name} :End of /NAMES list.")
        else
            names_reply(&server, client, room)

void whois(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters == 0
        reply(&server, client, 431, ":No nickname given")
        return
    other := find_user(server, parameters[0])
    if other < 0
        reply(&server, client, 401, "{parameters[0]} :No such nick/channel")
        reply(&server, client, 318, "{parameters[0]} :End of /WHOIS list.")
        return
    person := server.people[other]
    reply(&server, client, 311, "{person.nickname} {person.username} {person.host} * :{person.realname}")
    if #person.channels > 0
        reply(&server, client, 319, "{person.nickname} :" + joined_channels(server, other, " "))
    reply(&server, client, 312, "{person.nickname} " + setting(server.settings, "NAME") + " :" + setting(server.settings, "DESCRIPTION"))
    if person.away != ""
        reply(&server, client, 301, "{person.nickname} :{person.away}")
    reply(&server, client, 317, "{person.nickname} {server.tick - person.last_speaking} {person.signon} :seconds idle, signon time")
    reply(&server, client, 318, "{person.nickname} :End of /WHOIS list.")

void invite(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters < 2
        reply(&server, client, 461, "INVITE :Not enough parameters")
        return
    other := find_user(server, parameters[0])
    if other < 0
        reply(&server, client, 401, "{parameters[0]} :No such nick/channel")
        return
    room := find_channel(server, parameters[1])
    if room < 0
        reply(&server, client, 403, "{parameters[1]} :No such channel")
        return
    member := channels.member(server.rooms[room], client)
    name := server.rooms[room].name
    if member < 0
        reply(&server, client, 442, "{name} :You're not on that channel")
        return
    if channels.member(server.rooms[room], other) >= 0
        reply(&server, client, 443, "{server.people[other].nickname} {name} :is already on channel")
        return
    if server.rooms[room].flags.has("i") and not server.rooms[room].members[member].op
        reply(&server, client, 482, "{name} :You're not channel operator")
        return
    if not contains(server.people[other].invites, room)
        server.people[other].invites = server.people[other].invites.append(room)
    reply(&server, client, 341, "{server.people[other].nickname} {name}")
    if server.people[other].away != ""
        reply(&server, client, 301, "{server.people[other].nickname} :{server.people[other].away}")
    send(&server, other, ":" + clients.prefix(server.people[client]) + " INVITE {server.people[other].nickname} :{name}")

void kick(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    if #parameters < 2
        reply(&server, client, 461, "KICK :Not enough parameters")
        return
    room := find_channel(server, parameters[0])
    if room < 0
        reply(&server, client, 403, "{parameters[0]} :No such channel")
        return
    member := channels.member(server.rooms[room], client)
    name := server.rooms[room].name
    if member < 0
        reply(&server, client, 442, "{name} :You're not on that channel")
        return
    if not server.rooms[room].members[member].op
        reply(&server, client, 482, "{name} :You're not channel operator")
        return
    other := find_user(server, parameters[1])
    if other < 0
        reply(&server, client, 401, "{parameters[1]} :No such nick/channel")
        return
    if channels.member(server.rooms[room], other) < 0
        reply(&server, client, 441, "{server.people[other].nickname} {name} :They aren't on that channel")
        return
    reason := if #parameters >= 3 and parameters[2] != "" then parameters[2] else server.people[client].nickname
    broadcast(&server, room, ":" + clients.prefix(server.people[client]) + " KICK {name} {server.people[other].nickname} :{reason}")
    remove_member(&server, other, room)

void user_mode(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    other := find_user(server, parameters[0])
    if other < 0
        reply(&server, client, 401, "{parameters[0]} :No such nick/channel")
        return
    if other != client
        reply(&server, client, 502, ":Cannot change mode for other users")
        return
    if #parameters == 1
        reply(&server, client, 221, clients.mode(server.people[client]))
        return
    modes.Item[] changes := []
    sign := "+"
    unknown := false
    for: i < int(#parameters[1])
        character := parameters[1][i]
        if character == "+" or character == "-"
            sign = character
        elif character == "i"
            value := sign == "+"
            if server.people[client].invisible != value
                server.people[client].invisible = value
                changes = changes.append(modes.Item(sign, "i"))
        else
            unknown = true
    if #changes > 0
        nickname := server.people[client].nickname
        send(&server, client, ":{nickname} MODE {nickname} :" + modes.change_string(changes))
    if unknown
        reply(&server, client, 501, ":Unknown MODE flag")

void channel_mode(Server &server, int client, string[] parameters)
    room := find_channel(server, parameters[0])
    if room < 0
        reply(&server, client, 403, "{parameters[0]} :No such channel")
        return
    name := server.rooms[room].name
    member := channels.member(server.rooms[room], client)
    if #parameters == 1
        reply(&server, client, 324, name + " " + channels.mode_display(server.rooms[room], member >= 0))
        reply(&server, client, 329, "{name} {server.rooms[room].created}")
        return
    privileged := member >= 0 and server.rooms[room].members[member].op
    denied := false
    listed := false
    modes.Item[] changes := []
    for item := modes.channel_items(parameters[1], parameters[2:])[]
        string character := item.character
        if not "biklmnotv".contains(character)
            reply(&server, client, 472, "{character} :is unknown mode char to me for {name}")
            continue
        if character == "b" and not item.present
            if item.sign == "+" and not listed
                for ban := server.rooms[room].bans[]
                    reply(&server, client, 367, "{name} {ban.mask} {ban.setter} {ban.tick}")
                reply(&server, client, 368, "{name} :End of channel ban list")
                listed = true
            continue
        if ((character == "o" or character == "v") and not item.present) or (item.sign == "+" and (character == "k" or character == "l") and not item.present)
            continue
        if not privileged
            if not denied
                reply(&server, client, 482, "{name} :You're not channel operator")
                denied = true
            continue
        adding := item.sign == "+"
        changed := false
        if character == "o" or character == "v"
            other := find_user(server, item.argument)
            if other < 0
                reply(&server, client, 401, "{item.argument} :No such nick/channel")
                continue
            position := channels.member(server.rooms[room], other)
            if position < 0
                reply(&server, client, 441, "{server.people[other].nickname} {name} :They aren't on that channel")
                continue
            bool old := if character == "o" then server.rooms[room].members[position].op else server.rooms[room].members[position].voice
            if old != adding
                if character == "o"
                    server.rooms[room].members[position].op = adding
                else
                    server.rooms[room].members[position].voice = adding
                item.argument = server.people[other].nickname
                changed = true
        elif character == "b"
            mask := masks.normalize(item.argument)
            existing := -1
            for: i < int(#server.rooms[room].bans)
                if protocol.fold(server.rooms[room].bans[i].mask) == protocol.fold(mask)
                    existing = i
                    break
            if adding and existing < 0
                server.rooms[room].bans = server.rooms[room].bans.append(channels.Ban(mask, server.people[client].nickname, server.tick))
                item.argument = mask
                changed = true
            elif not adding and existing >= 0
                item.argument = server.rooms[room].bans[existing].mask
                server.rooms[room].bans = [for i := (0:<(int(#server.rooms[room].bans)))[] if i != existing then server.rooms[room].bans[i]]
                changed = true
        elif character == "k"
            if adding
                if server.rooms[room].key != ""
                    reply(&server, client, 467, "{name} :Channel key already set")
                else
                    server.rooms[room].key = item.argument
                    changed = true
            elif server.rooms[room].key != ""
                server.rooms[room].key = ""
                item.argument = "*"
                changed = true
        elif character == "l"
            if adding
                limit := int(item.argument)
                if server.rooms[room].limit != limit
                    server.rooms[room].limit = limit
                    item.argument = "{limit}"
                    changed = true
            elif server.rooms[room].limit != 0
                server.rooms[room].limit = 0
                changed = true
        else
            if server.rooms[room].flags.has(character) != adding
                if adding
                    .server.rooms[room].flags.add(character)
                else
                    .server.rooms[room].flags.remove(character)
                changed = true
        if changed
            changes = changes.append(item)
    if #changes > 0
        broadcast(&server, room, ":" + clients.prefix(server.people[client]) + " MODE {name} " + modes.change_string(changes))

void process_line(Server &server, int client, string raw)
    .server.counts.increment("processed")
    parsed := protocol.parse(raw)
    command := parsed.command
    parameters := parsed.parameters
    if command == ""
        .server.counts.increment("empty")
        return
    .server.commands.increment(command)
    if not server.people[client].registered and command != "NICK" and command != "USER" and command != "PING" and command != "PONG" and command != "QUIT"
        reply(&server, client, 451, ":You have not registered")
        return
    if command == "NICK"
        nick(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "USER"
        user(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "PING"
        if #parameters == 0 or parameters[0] == ""
            reply(&server, client, 409, ":No origin specified")
        else
            name := setting(server.settings, "NAME")
            send(&server, client, ":{name} PONG {name} :{parameters[0]}")
    elif command == "PONG"
        return
    elif command == "QUIT"
        reason := if #parameters > 0 and parameters[0] != "" then "Quit: " + parameters[0] else "Client Quit"
        disconnect(&server, client, reason, "quit")
    elif command == "JOIN"
        join(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "PART"
        part(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "PRIVMSG" or command == "NOTICE"
        message(&server, client, command, parameters)
    elif command == "TOPIC"
        topic(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "NAMES"
        handle_names(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "WHOIS"
        whois(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "AWAY"
        server.people[client].away = if #parameters > 0 then parameters[0] else ""
        if server.people[client].away == ""
            reply(&server, client, 305, ":You are no longer marked as being away")
        else
            reply(&server, client, 306, ":You have been marked as being away")
    elif command == "INVITE"
        invite(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "KICK"
        kick(&server, client, parameters)
    elif command == "MODE"
        if #parameters == 0
            reply(&server, client, 461, "MODE :Not enough parameters")
        elif parameters[0].starts_with("#")
            channel_mode(&server, client, parameters)
        else
            user_mode(&server, client, parameters)
    else
        reply(&server, client, 421, "{command} :Unknown command")

void arrival(Server &server, Traffic event)
    .server.counts.increment(event.kind)
    if event.kind == "connect"
        server.people = server.people.append(clients.Client(event.identifier, event.body[8:], server.tick, number(server.settings, "BUCKET")))
        active := 0
        for client := server.people[]
            if client.active
                active += 1
        if active > server.peak_connections
            server.peak_connections = active
            server.peak_connection_time = server.tick
        return
    index := connection(server, event.identifier)
    if event.kind == "disconnect"
        if index >= 0
            disconnect(&server, index, "Remote host closed the connection", "closed")
        return
    if index < 0
        .server.counts.increment("dropped")
        return
    &client := &server.people[index]
    client.received += 1
    client.last_received = server.tick
    client.ping_sent = -1
    if #client.queue == 0 and client.tokens >= 1
        clients.use_token(&client, server.tick, number(server.settings, "BUCKET"), number(server.settings, "REFILL"))
        process_line(&server, index, event.body)
    elif int(#client.queue) >= number(server.settings, "QUEUE")
        .server.counts.increment("discarded")
        disconnect(&server, index, "Excess Flood", "flood")
    else
        client.queue = client.queue.append(event.body)
        .server.counts.increment("queued")

void run(Server &server)
    traffic_index := 0
    for: tick <= server.end
        server.tick = tick
        for: index < int(#server.people)
            if not server.people[index].active
                continue
            clients.refill(&server.people[index], tick, number(server.settings, "BUCKET"), number(server.settings, "REFILL"))
            while server.people[index].active and #server.people[index].queue > 0 and server.people[index].tokens > 0
                clients.use_token(&server.people[index], tick, number(server.settings, "BUCKET"), number(server.settings, "REFILL"))
                raw := server.people[index].queue[0]
                server.people[index].queue = server.people[index].queue[1:]
                process_line(&server, index, raw)
        while traffic_index < int(#server.traffic) and server.traffic[traffic_index].tick == tick
            arrival(&server, server.traffic[traffic_index])
            traffic_index += 1
        for: index < int(#server.people)
            client := server.people[index]
            if not client.active
                continue
            if client.ping_sent >= 0
                if tick - client.ping_sent >= number(server.settings, "TIMEOUT")
                    disconnect(&server, index, "Ping timeout: {tick - client.last_received} seconds", "timeout")
            elif tick - client.last_received >= number(server.settings, "PINGFREQ")
                send(&server, index, "PING :" + setting(server.settings, "NAME"))
                .server.counts.increment("pings")
                server.people[index].ping_sent = tick

string[] channel_report(Server server)
    string[] lines := []
    total := 0
    members := 0
    bans := 0
    for channel := server.rooms[]
        if not channel.active
            continue
        total += 1
        members += int(#channel.members)
        bans += int(#channel.bans)
        lines = lines.append("CHANNEL {channel.name} created {channel.created} members {#channel.members} peak {channel.peak} messages {channel.messages} modes " + channels.mode_display(channel))
        lines = lines.append(if channel.topic == "" then "TOPIC none" else "TOPIC {channel.topic_setter} {channel.topic_time} {channel.topic}")
        for ban := channel.bans[]
            lines = lines.append("BAN {ban.mask} {ban.setter} {ban.tick}")
        names := [for member := channel.members[] then channels.status(member) + server.people[member.client].nickname].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append("MEMBERS " + names)
    return lines.append("TOTAL channels {total} members {members} bans {bans}")

string[] client_report(Server server)
    string[] lines := []
    active := 0
    registered := 0
    invisible := 0
    away := 0
    for: index < int(#server.people)
        client := server.people[index]
        if not client.active
            continue
        active += 1
        if client.registered
            registered += 1
        if client.invisible
            invisible += 1
        if client.away != ""
            away += 1
        username := if client.username == "" then "*" else client.username
        signon := if client.registered then "{client.signon}" else "-"
        joined := joined_channels(server, index, ",")
        invites := [for room := client.invites[] then server.rooms[room].name].join(",")
        if joined == ""
            joined = "none"
        if invites == ""
            invites = "none"
        lines = lines.append("CLIENT {client.identifier} " + clients.addressee(client) + " {username} {client.host} " + clients.mode(client) + " connected {client.connected} signon {signon} received {client.received} sent {client.sent} tokens {client.tokens} queue {#client.queue} channels {joined} invites {invites}")
        if client.away != ""
            lines = lines.append("AWAY {client.identifier} {client.away}")
    return lines.append("TOTAL clients {active} registered {registered} invisible {invisible} away {away}")

string[] statistics(Server server)
    pending := 0
    numerics := 0
    for client := server.people[]
        if client.active
            pending += int(#client.queue)
    for value := server.numerics.values()[]
        numerics += value
    c := server.counts
    lines := [
        "END {server.end}",
        "LINES total {#server.traffic} connect {count(c, "connect")} disconnect {count(c, "disconnect")} messages {count(c, "messages")}",
        "MESSAGES dropped {count(c, "dropped")} queued {count(c, "queued")} processed {count(c, "processed")} discarded {count(c, "discarded")} pending {pending} empty {count(c, "empty")}",
        "SENT lines {#server.sent} numerics {numerics} pings {count(c, "pings")} errors {count(c, "errors")}"
    ]
    for command := server.commands.keys().sorted()[]
        lines = lines.append("COMMAND {command} {count(server.commands, command)}")
    for code := server.numerics.keys().sorted()[]
        match server.numerics.get(code)
            int value
                lines = lines.append("NUMERIC {code:03.} {value}")
            none
                continue
    lines = lines.append("PEAK connections {server.peak_connections} at {server.peak_connection_time}")
    lines = lines.append("PEAK registered {server.peak_registered} at {server.peak_registration_time}")
    d := server.disconnections
    lines = lines.append("DISCONNECTS quit {count(d, "quit")} closed {count(d, "closed")} flood {count(d, "flood")} timeout {count(d, "timeout")}")
    return lines.concat(server.gone)

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    destination := file.write("output/" + filename)
    if #lines > 0
        .destination(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    server := Server(read_settings(), read_traffic())
    run(&server)
    if not file.exists("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("sent.txt", server.sent)
    write_lines("channels.txt", channel_report(server))
    write_lines("clients.txt", client_report(server))
    write_lines("stats.txt", statistics(server))

run_program()

import protocol = "./protocol.qui"

bool matches(string mask, string text)
    pattern := protocol.fold(mask)
    value := protocol.fold(text)
    position := 0
    cursor := 0
    star := -1
    restart := 0
    while position < int(#value)
        if cursor < int(#pattern) and pattern[cursor] == "*"
            star = cursor
            cursor += 1
            restart = position
        elif cursor < int(#pattern) and (pattern[cursor] == "?" or pattern[cursor] == value[position])
            cursor += 1
            position += 1
        elif star >= 0
            restart += 1
            position = restart
            cursor = star + 1
        else
            return false
    while cursor < int(#pattern) and pattern[cursor] == "*"
        cursor += 1
    return cursor == int(#pattern)

string normalize(string argument)
    if argument.contains("!") and argument.contains("@")
        return argument
    if argument.contains("@")
        return "*!" + argument
    if argument.contains("!")
        return argument + "@*"
    if argument.contains(".")
        return "*!*@" + argument
    return argument + "!*@*"

import protocol = "./protocol.qui"

class Item(string sign, string character, present := false, argument := "")

Item[] channel_items(string mode, string[] arguments)
    Item[] items := []
    sign := "+"
    position := 0
    for: index < int(#mode)
        character := mode[index]
        if character == "+" or character == "-"
            sign = character
            continue
        present := false
        argument := ""
        if "ovbk".contains(character) or (character == "l" and sign == "+")
            if position < int(#arguments)
                argument = arguments[position]
                present = true
                position += 1
        if character == "k" and sign == "-"
            present = true
            argument = "*"
        elif character == "l" and sign == "+"
            if not present or not protocol.digits(argument) or #argument > 4 or int(argument) < 1
                present = false
        items = items.append(Item(sign, character, present, argument))
    return items

string change_string(Item[] changes)
    result := ""
    previous := ""
    string[] arguments := []
    for change := changes[]
        if change.sign != previous
            result += change.sign
            previous = change.sign
        result += change.character
        if change.present
            arguments = arguments.append(change.argument)
    return result + (if #arguments == 0 then "" else " " + arguments.join(" "))

class Message(string command, string[] parameters)

string letters()
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

string fold(string value)
    result := ""
    lower := value.lower_ascii()
    for: i < int(#lower)
        c := lower[i]
        result += if c == "[" then "{{" elif c == "]" then "}}" elif c == "\" then "|" elif c == "^" then "~" else c
    return result

bool digits(string value)
    if #value == 0
        return false
    for: i < int(#value)
        if not "0123456789".contains(value[i])
            return false
    return true

bool valid_nickname(string value)
    first := letters() + "[]\`_^{{|}}"
    rest := first + "0123456789-"
    if #value == 0 or not first.contains(value[0])
        return false
    for: 1 <= i < int(#value)
        if not rest.contains(value[i])
            return false
    return true

bool valid_channel(string value, int maximum)
    return #value >= 2 and int(#value) <= maximum and value.starts_with("#") and not value.contains(":")

Message parse(string raw)
    position := 0
    if raw.starts_with(":")
        while position < int(#raw) and raw[position] != " "
            position += 1
    while position < int(#raw) and raw[position] == " "
        position += 1
    first := position
    while position < int(#raw) and raw[position] != " "
        position += 1
    command := raw[first:<position].upper_ascii()
    string[] parameters := []
    while position < int(#raw)
        while position < int(#raw) and raw[position] == " "
            position += 1
        if position == int(#raw)
            break
        if raw[position] == ":"
            parameters = parameters.append(raw[position + 1:])
            break
        if #parameters == 14
            parameters = parameters.append(raw[position:])
            break
        first = position
        while position < int(#raw) and raw[position] != " "
            position += 1
        parameters = parameters.append(raw[first:<position])
    return Message(command, parameters)
